items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer asks: 'What did you do in between the time you were with this stage band and Larkin?' The interviewee does not confirm or deny knowing Larkin, nor does he describe a relationship, only correcting the interviewer's assumption about the timeline/sequence.

ctx.x: Wait just a second. What did you do in between the time you were with this stage band and Larkin? Milt Loggins? Or did you go from the stage band to Milt?
